title: Update Azure AI Foundry (Anthropic) and Gemini judge defaults to current models

files.patch:
@@ -208,12 +208,12 @@ class LlmProvider adapter: 'LlmJudgeAdapters::Anthropic', auth_style: :x_api_key, default_service_url: 'https://RESOURCE.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic', - default_model: 'claude-3-5-haiku-20241022', + default_model: 'claude-haiku-5-5', help_html: <<~HTML.squish, Azure AI Foundry (Anthropic) — Claude models via Azure using the native Anthropic Messages API.
URL: https://YOUR-RESOURCE.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic
- Model: e.g. claude-3-5-haiku-20241022
+ Model: e.g. claude-haiku-5-5
Key: Azure AI services key (sent as x-api-key header)
API Version: Leave blank (the anthropic-version header is set automatically) HTML @@ -237,11 +237,11 @@ class LlmProvider key: 'google_gemini', label: 'Google Gemini', default_service_url: 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai', - default_model: 'gemini-2.0-flash', + default_model: 'gemini-3.8-flash', help_html: <<~HTML.squish, Google Gemini — Uses the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
URL: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai
- Model: e.g. gemini-2.0-flash
+ Model: e.g. gemini-3.8-flash
Key: Your Google AI API key
API Version: Leave blank HTML

@@ -208,7 +208,7 @@ class SampleData < Thor
     azure_anthropic_judge.judge_options = {
       llm_provider:    'azure_ai_foundry_anthropic',
       llm_service_url: 'https://YOUR-RESOURCE.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic',
-      llm_model:       'claude-3-5-haiku-20241022',
+      llm_model:       'claude-haiku-5-5',
       llm_timeout:     30,
       llm_api_version: '',
     }

@@ -14,12 +14,12 @@ class LlmProviderTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
                                        'https://MODEL-NAME.REGION.models.ai.azure.com', '', '' ],

                                        'https://RESOURCE.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic', '',
-                                       'claude-3-5-haiku-20241022' ],
+                                       'claude-haiku-5-5' ],
     'anthropic'                   => [ 'Anthropic', 'https://api.anthropic.com', '',
                                        'claude-sonnet-5-5' ],
     'google_gemini'               => [ 'Google Gemini',
                                        'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai', '',

     'ollama'                      => [ 'Ollama', :from_config, '', 'qwen3:0.6b' ],
